title: New Lower Bounds for Private PAC Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study realizable PAC learning under approximate differential privacy, and give a framework for proving lower bounds on its sample complexity. We construct classes with identical VC and Littlestone dimensions but different private sample complexities at common privacy and accuracy parameters, showing that these dimensions do not determine the sample complexity, even for improper learners. To address this we introduce the Independent Class Packing (ICP) parameter, the largest total sample complexity of classes in $\mathcal{G}$ that can be packed independently into a class $\mathcal{H}$, and prove that every $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-DP, $(\alpha, \beta)$-PAC learner for $\mathcal{H}$, possibly improper, uses $\Omega\left(\mathrm{ICP}(\mathcal{H}, \mathcal{G})/(\alpha\varepsilon)\right)$ examples. Using this framework we prove tight lower bounds for axis-aligned rectangles, union of intervals and linear subspaces and improved lower bounds

translated_abstract: 我们研究了近似差分隐私下的可实现PAC学习，并给出了证明其样本复杂度下界的框架。我们构造了具有相同VC维和Littlestone维、但在相同隐私和精度参数下却具有不同私有样本复杂度的假设类，表明这些维度并不能决定样本复杂度，即使对于非正规学习器也是如此。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了独立类打包（ICP）参数，即可以独立打包进类 $\mathcal{H}$ 的 $\mathcal{G}$ 中各类的最大总样本复杂度，并证明了任何针对 $\mathcal{H}$ 的 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-DP、$(\alpha, \beta)$-PAC学习器（包括非正规学习器）都需要使用 $\Omega\left(\mathrm{ICP}(\mathcal{H}, \mathcal{G})/(\alpha\varepsilon)\right)$ 个样本。利用该框架，我们证明了轴对齐矩形、区间并集和线性子空间的紧下界以及改进的下界。
tldr: 本文提出了私有PAC学习样本复杂度下界的统一证明框架，引入独立类打包（ICP）参数证明VC维和Littlestone维无法决定私有样本复杂度，并据此给出了轴对齐矩形、区间并集和线性子空间的紧下界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework for proving lower bounds on the sample complexity of private PAC learning via a new Independent Class Packing (ICP) parameter, demonstrating that VC and Littlestone dimensions do not determine private sample complexity, and establishing tight lower bounds for axis-aligned rectangles, unions of intervals, and linear subspaces.
